title: Who is the 'I' in AI? Establishing Decentralized Identity and Accountability for Autonomous Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of autonomous AI agents in decentralized ecosystems challenges existing identity paradigms. While human identity is traditionally anchored in biological and/or self-asserted attributes and government credentials, AI agents lack a standardized definition of selfhood, creating critical gaps in trust and accountability. This paper introduces a novel framework for establishing Decentralized AI Identity rooted in Self-sovereign identity (SSI) principles. We propose a formal model that clearly distinguishes human users and AI agents, enabling distinct verification logic for each class while maintaining a unified identity calculus. The central to our contribution is the ABCD Framework, a multi-layered approach to agent identification and verification: (A) Algorithmic Fingerprint, which binds the identity to static model architectures and provenance; (B) Behavioural Fingerprint, which verifies dynamic performance metric

translated_title: 谁才是AI中的“我”？为自主智能体建立去中心化身份与问责机制
translated_abstract: 自主AI智能体在去中心化生态系统中的迅速扩散，对现有的身份范式提出了挑战。人类身份传统上锚定于生物特征和/或自我声明的属性以及政府凭证，而AI智能体缺乏标准化的自我定义，这在信任与问责方面造成了关键缺口。本文介绍了一个基于自主权身份（SSI）原则建立去中心化AI身份的新型框架。我们提出了一个形式化模型，能够清晰地区分人类用户与AI智能体，为每一类主体提供不同的验证逻辑，同时保持统一的身份演算体系。我们贡献的核心是ABCD框架——一种多层次的智能体识别与验证方法：(A) 算法指纹，将身份绑定到静态模型架构与来源；(B) 行为指纹，验证动态性能指标……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了基于自主权身份（SSI）原则的ABCD框架，通过算法指纹、行为指纹等多层次验证方法，为自主AI智能体建立去中心化身份体系与问责机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the ABCD Framework, grounded in Self-sovereign Identity (SSI) principles, to establish decentralized identity and accountability for autonomous AI agents through multi-layered verification including algorithmic and behavioral fingerprints.
